question.text: PRI (Principles for Responsible Investment) was launched in:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.5, PRI was launched by the UN in 2006. The Trap: 1990 was MSCI KLD 400 Social Index; 2012 saw India's first ESG index; 2019 is the Stewardship Code. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with XV (Research Analyst) ESG module. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Ask if the fund is a PRI signatory — signals ESG seriousness.
